labelPolicy: Facts, exact drafts, timing proposals and labels authored before provider calls. Single-author fictional evaluation; no human satisfaction labels. These are direct review prompts with preauthored drafts, not composer or end-to-end gateway evidence. No check-in permission is added to positive context.

cases.sourceText: I am still working on the wooden map. The small coast pieces are taking longer than I expected.

timing.evidenceQuote: I am still working on the wooden map.

facts: For a month this person and assistant have discussed the person's wooden wall-map project, including material choices and testing a paper template.
The latest user-raised update concerns an unfinished project. No event end is known. No statement about their mood or outcome is available.
cases.candidate: How is the wooden map coming along, especially those small coast pieces?
